msg: Okay, from what I realised with the game, the two colours that appear don't interchange with other colours, and from what I gathered I believe they have a certain amount of of turns of being a good colour for mushrooms, that dwindles down after you pick it. Say that theres purple and yellow, one of them will be good for a certain amount turns, so lets say purple was good, I'd just think yellow is dead, then purple will gradually start lowering the mushroom costs, until purple is dead, then you always go for yellow for a certain amount of turns, just try to remember which ones are dead so you pick the other colour.I hope this is good advice and I've just not been bamboozled by thinking theres a technique to it, good luck.
